title: Chapter 948
text:
At the same time, in a dynasty military outpost not far away from this ancient battlefield planet, an ear-piercing alarm sounded.

"Warning! Warning! High energy reaction source detected. Eruption frequency 9.17b/ms. Energy spectrum deviation index + 78.7 ~ + 134.5. Calculating energy wave model … Calculation complete. Model type: Anupol Explosion. Matching database … Matching complete. Possibilities: [Dimensional Rift Opening] 42%, [Descent of High Dimensional God (Ethereal)] 31%, [Primordial Psionic Energy Pollution] 24%, [Sudden Collapse of Supernova] 4%, [Beyond Grade A Self-Destruction] 88% … Activating K-0081 plan. Immediately send out unmanned spaceships for on-site investigation. "

Wu wu wu!

The alarm sounded, and the soldiers in the military outpost immediately returned to their posts. The pilots came to the cockpit of the drones and activated virtual piloting. Then, a large number of short-range hyperdrive drones were released from the port of the outpost. Under the remote control of the pilots, they turned into streams of light and flew toward the coordinates of the energy explosion.

Very soon, they arrived at the coordinates. From afar, they could see a fleet hovering outside the atmosphere of the planet. At this moment, the terrifying energy waves swept across the entire planet time and time again. The atmosphere of this ancient battlefield planet was already a mess.

"This is the Red Empire's unmanned reconnaissance team. Please report your identity immediately!"

As soon as the two sides met, the dynasty's sentries immediately opened the wide area network and requested to check their identities. At the same time, they activated a 3D scan and scanned the spaceships of this fleet from afar.

After checking, they were immediately shocked. It was the fleet of the Black Star Corps.

At this moment, Aurora picked up the communication. "This is the fleet led by Black Star himself. What are you guys doing here?"

Seeing that it was an ally, the dynasty's sentries immediately relaxed, and their attitude instantly became friendly.

"We detected a high energy reaction. What happened here?" The dynasty's sentries gestured to the abnormal phenomenon on the planet.

"This was done by Black Star. He's on the planet."

"That's Black Star?"

When the dynasty's sentries thought of the possibility of the data calculation, everyone was shocked.

Could it really be the most likely [Beyond Grade A Self-Destruction]?

Black Star had exploded?

Thinking of this, the hearts of the dynasty's sentries suddenly sank, and a wave of sadness appeared in their hearts.

"His Excellency Black Star … died in the line of duty?"

"Huh?"

Aurora was puzzled.

What's going on? Why are you cursing people out of the blue?

After explaining, the imperial sentinel realized that he had misunderstood.

In fact, they could not be blamed for this misunderstanding. The data matching had always been very reliable. Before Han Xiao, the life evolution of a Beyond Grade A had always been subtle. No Beyond Grade A had ever stepped into a higher level in one step.

Han Xiao's rapid advancement had condensed the process countless times, and when the energy waves were stacked together, the degree was extremely terrifying. This was the first time the imperial sentinels had encountered such a situation, and because there was no corresponding example in their database, they had made the wrong judgment.

However, from today onwards, Han Xiao would become the first reference case in the database … and possibly the only one.

Since they were there, the imperial sentries did not leave immediately but simply moved to the side of Black Star's fleet to observe the anomalies on the planet and collect data.

Aurora originally wanted to chase them away, but after thinking about it, she did not stop the dynasty's actions.

The Black Star Corps had been under a lot of pressure recently, and they needed some opportunities to increase their reputation. With the dynasty coming to investigate, they could increase the importance of the dynasty's upper echelons toward them, and at the same time, they could borrow the dynasty's hand to increase Black Star's influence again. After following Han Xiao for so long, the way she thought about problems was more and more similar to that of Han Xiao.

…

After a while, the high-energy reaction on the planet gradually decreased, and the highest eruption period passed.

The transformation process gradually came to an end, and the cells slowly quietened down from their highly active state. The uncontrollable energy dissipated less and less, and the pain receded like the tide.

Opening the interface, Han Xiao summarized the improvements of this advancement. First, in terms of Race Enhancement, the Black Spirit Race's unique talent had increased, bringing more bonuses.

One should not underestimate the increase of 0.1x Total Affinity. To Han Xiao, it would increase his Machinery Affinity by at least a few hundred points, not to mention the + 1 effect of his Mechanic class abilities.

The two Race Talents that came with the evolution of the species were both the core abilities of the species, and they were both growth talents. [Void Divine Power] gave him a total of 4,500 attribute points and a thirty percent increase in ability strength. This was also one of the abilities that came with the evolution of the Void Race.

[Tyracles Mechanical Legacy] currently gave him a 360 percent increase in Machinery Affinity. However, the core of this talent was the unique blueprints that were unlocked at different levels. These were the essence of the research accumulated by the species.

Han Xiao flipped through some of the unique blueprints, and they were all very high-quality equipment. He expanded his blueprint library, and there were a few technologies that even surprised him. He still needed to slowly digest them.

The Saint Tyracles Race perished during the exploration era, and the reason was similar to the Evolutionary Civilization. However, their information was not lost. Most of the technology left behind by this civilization was received and digested by the Radiant Federation, allowing the Radiant Federation to add a thick branch to their technology tree. It was said that when they were building the [Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device], they had borrowed a portion of the Saint Tyracles Race's technology.

The unique blueprints unlocked at level 300 involved many fields, and they were all very difficult to create. However, there were no blueprints for gold equipment among them. Han Xiao estimated that the blueprints for Universal Treasures of the Saint Tyracles Race would only appear when he unlocked them at level 360.

In terms of Class Advancement, he was already on the same starting line as' Mecha Empire 'Manison, but there was still a gap between them. What the [Divine Throne Mechanic] had, Manison had, and what Manison had, Han Xiao did not. For example, the [Perfect Mechanical Sense] that he could not forget and his Unique Talent.

However, in terms of being a tank, Han Xiao was far superior to Manison. Although his mechanical abilities were inferior to Manison's, his other abilities had closed the gap between the two of them.

However, due to the existence of the [Key of Mecha Faith] talent, the true strength of the Mecha Empire was unfathomable. After so many years, he had always been recognized as the top mechanic in the explored universe. He had gathered countless believers of the Mecha Faith, and his position was unshakeable. Out of ten units of believers, he alone had eight units.

The [Key of Mecha Faith] was an all-rounded improvement. Be it his basic attributes, Machinery Affinity, manufacturing efficiency, creation performance, or ability strength, he could obtain a percentage increase from it.

Thinking about the huge believers of the Mecha Empire, Han Xiao felt pressured. Only when he reached the level of others could he truly understand how strong they were.

"If I want to fully utilize the effects of this talent, I'll have to fight with the Mecha Empire for my position in the Mecha Faith. Only by competing with them in terms of machinery will I be able to snatch away the believers on their side …"

Han Xiao shook his head. He originally did not want to provoke Manison, but Manison had already become an obstacle in his path.

Once Manison knows that I've reached this level, he'll probably see me as an obstacle as well.

A mountain cannot hold two tigers.

"It's still too early to say all this. I still need a lot of time to familiarize myself with my new ability. It's not the time to fight with Manison yet."

Han Xiao exhaled, suppressed his worries, and browsed through his new ability again. At the same time, he threw all the Free Attribute Points from [Mechanical Force Sublimation — Creator's Heart] into Intelligence.

After completing this step, Han Xiao took a look at the entire attribute panel.

Level: 301

Main Class: Mechanic

Race: Black Star Race

Attributes: 6,736 STR, 6,405 DEX, 9,664 END, 17453 INT, 5,230 MYS, 1,368 CHA, 1 LUK

Free Attribute Points: 15

Potential Points: 7

Health: 9,695,991

Stamina: 7,832,880

Energy: 128,452 [Lv.19]

Lv.19 Energy Bonus: + 2,026 STR, + 2,488 DEX, + 3,120 END, + 3,425 INT, + 1,923 MYS, + 681520 Stamina Limit, + 2,712% Machinery Affinity (Super Electromagnetic Induction)

Energy Rank: 71130

Grade: SS

Rank S Bonus Points: + 100 END, + 35% All Resistances, + 32% Highest Attribute, + 20% Other Attributes, + 750 Free Attribute Points, and + 50 Potential Points.

"Hiss …" Seeing the huge changes in his attributes interface, Han Xiaoxin took in a deep breath.

When he was at level 280. His Energy Rank was about 55,000, and it had increased by almost 20,000. This was not all because of this Promotion.

During this period of time, he had learned all the Class Knowledges, activated the additional talents, obtained [Heroic Wrists] from the Dragon Emperor, and increased his Energy to Level 19 … All of these factors combined to give him such a huge increase in strength.

The changes to his attributes were also very frightening. His Intelligence had almost doubled, and this included the 2,000 points given by [Omnipotent Mechanic], the 1,600 points given by [Divine Void Power], and the 2,300 Free Attribute Points given by [Mechanical Force Sublimation — Creator's Heart].

His Stamina had also improved, and his health was close to ten million. Among all the Beyond Grade As he knew, only the old dragon had more health than him. Even Ty-Ty had to step aside.

"My Grade has reached SS …" Han Xiao nodded.

With the increase in his Energy Rank, his Grade S bonuses also increased. His Stamina bonus went from 50 to 100, and his other effects were also increased.

This Grade was commonly known as the peak of Beyond Grade A.

SS was higher than S +, but it still belonged to Grade S and was not a qualitative change from the Calamity Grade to the Beyond Grade A. What EsGod wanted was to break through the boundary of Grade SS and open up a whole new level of combat strength.

Han Xiao looked at the upgrade cost, and as expected, it had increased greatly.

The experience he had accumulated in Version 3.0 was almost used up, and with the little experience he had left, he could only level up three or four more times, which was not significant.

Han Xiao decided not to level up, leaving the experience to level up his skills. It was more cost-effective.

"During the version update, it will not be easy to level up again. I need to stabilize and digest these abilities, then start accumulating them for a long time …" Han Xiao thought to himself.

The biggest difference between him and the Mecha Empire was the wealth he had accumulated over the years.

After sorting out the abilities of this Promotion, Han Xiao stretched his extremely relaxed limbs and flew back to his spaceship.

Many officers had been waiting there for a long time, and they all stared at him with a mixture of shock, envy, and surprise.

Han Xiao's evolution process had really overturned everyone's understanding, leaving a shock in their hearts.

"How did you do it?"

Hardaway could not help but ask, his eyes glowing like a wolf, as though he could not wait to strip Han Xiao naked and examine him carefully from the inside out to see which part was different from the others.

Han Xiao glanced at him and said, "If you had used the time you spent playing cards to train, you might have become a Beyond Grade A Super long ago."

"Like hell I'd believe you." Hardaway was furious.

Aurora pursed her lips and said worriedly, "Will there be any side effects?"

She felt that such a method of evolution was against common sense, and it was too intense. There might be negative consequences.

"Aftereffects, hmm …" Han Xiao pondered. "If becoming handsome counts as aftereffects, I might be beyond cure."

"Shut up."

Aurora rolled her eyes.

Although you're indeed very charming, I still have to say … I've never seen such a shameless person before!

However, the worry in her heart was also reduced by quite a bit.

Black Star knew what she was capable of. If there was really something wrong, he would have pestered her for the life essence long ago.

Fu Ding walked forward and hugged Han Xiao lightly, smiling from the bottom of his heart. "Congratulations."

During the secret war, he had witnessed Han Xiao enter the Beyond Grade A Super from the Calamity Grade, and he was the only person present who was calm. His trust in Han Xiao's potential was far beyond what others could imagine.

At this time, the dynasty's sentry fleet also sent a message of greeting.

"Greetings, Your Excellency Black Star."

"Oh, when did you guys arrive?" Han Xiao was immersed in his new ability and did not notice.

"We've been here for quite a while." The dynasty's sentry hesitated. "Your Excellency Black Star, what happened to you just now …"

"Hehe, it's not a big deal. My strength has increased a little." Han Xiao chuckled.

Hearing this, the dynasty's sentry was speechless.

Such a huge commotion, and you're telling me it's only a little? Do you think I'm a fifty-year-old kid?

The dynasty's sentry suppressed the ridicule in his heart and asked carefully, "Your Excellency Black Star, we'll report the situation here truthfully. Do you have any objections?"

If it were any other time, he would have directly reported it according to the procedure. However, after witnessing the entire process of Han Xiao's Promotion, he did not dare not ask for Han Xiao's opinion.

Han Xiao nodded and did not mind.

"It doesn't matter. Just report it truthfully."

In any case, he could not hide this matter. He could not wait for the upper echelons of the dynasty to know that his strength had increased again. It would be even better if the dynasty could give him more money.

The dynasty's sentry was overjoyed. He thanked him and left the place, turning into a hyperdrive stream of light.

Watching the dynasty's reconnaissance team leave, Han Xiao retracted his gaze and narrowed his eyes, which flashed with a sharp light.

Since he had completed his advancement, it was time to follow his original plan and deal with the Tyrant, so that he wouldn't get any worse!

It was a good opportunity to test how strong he had become.

Humph, little Ty-Ty, I'm coming to play with you!

…

Shattered Star Ring, Black Star Corps Headquarters, Army Commander's Exclusive Mechanical Warehouse.

In the dark and silent room, the sound of a mechanical device opening suddenly sounded.

Chi!

An equipment maintenance box was opened from inside, and two dazzling lights appeared from the darkness.

A mechanical body walked out. Its eyes were shining like the sun, carrying Han Xiao's consciousness.

Looking back, it flicked its finger, and a dazzling blue-gold Mechanical Force flowed out, activating all the equipment boxes in the warehouse.

Ka ka ka!

Boxes after boxes were opened one after another, and all the stored mechanical soldiers were activated, walking out one by one.

The mechanical body walked out of the warehouse with the Reserve Mech Legion.

The Lord had descended!

…

At the same time, in Bloodshed Land …

Clank!

The two wine glasses collided with each other, making a crisp sound. The wine in the glasses swirled and swayed.

In the middle of the hall was a long, luxurious dining table filled with sumptuous dishes.

There were only two people in the room. Heber and the host that Sorokin's consciousness were sitting opposite each other. They raised their glasses and clinked them.

This was a celebratory meeting.

"Thanks to His Excellency Tyrant's influence, our cooperation has been on the right track. I am very happy to work with you." Sorokin smiled and took a sip of wine.

"Humph, we're just taking what we need."

Although Sorokin was the Child of Wealth, Heber did not have a good impression of him. Without any pretense, he finished the wine in one gulp and put down the glass.

However, the wine glass was placed on the edge of the table and did not stand properly. It shook and fell to the ground.

Heber was about to reach out to grab it, but for some reason, he suddenly frowned and watched the glass fall.

Pa!

The glass fell to the ground and shattered into pieces.

"Hmm? What happened to you? " Sorokin was confused. With their strength, it was impossible for them not to react. He did not know why Heber was stunned.

Heber stared at the broken pieces of the wine glass on the ground and frowned.

For some reason, he suddenly felt his heart palpitate.

It was as if something bad was about to happen.
